basics.name: Anupam Chugh
basics.label: App builder & editorial leader
basics.summary: I build apps, write about technology, and lead editorial work. I started with Android tutorials at JournalDev, led Better Programming as managing editor, and now build small Apple apps.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Consumer apps from idea to App Store, each from one human moment: 19 apps live and 65 approved releases since December 2025. Breakline reads how your body moves in your own clips across seven sports, and in testing a 3D humanoid robot replays your surf pop-up or push-up. Wearover changes the clothes in your photo and keeps your face exactly as it is (3.0 in App Review). Also Orbits, Rifflet, Screen Room and First Contact Duet.

work.name: Better Programming
work.summary: Took over from Zack Shapiro in 2021 and ran it until September 2023; it has been on hiatus since I left. Modified Zack's Better Publishing app for our Trello review queue, and built our outreach around RSS feeds of Medium topics and authors to find and onboard strong writers faster. Started Coffee Bytes, a Medium newsletter that put other writers in front of readers: weekly picks, roundups, author interviews, and a list of writers from age 10 to a septuagenarian learning Java. Over its life the publication carried 4.6K authors, 16.8K stories and 151M views, and paid writers close to $1M.

work.name: Agricx
work.summary: Led the Android team and planned work with the web and ML teams. Built the company’s first iOS app alone: a camera that grades crops on the device with OpenCV and AVFoundation.

work.name: MOBEY (Gold Coast, Australia)
work.summary: Built MOBEY’s alcohol-delivery apps, customer and driver, from nothing on Android, and redesigned their iOS apps in 2017. Featured on 7 News Brisbane.

work.name: JournalDev
work.summary: Taught myself Android by writing it up as I learned: 300+ tutorials on Android, Java, Kotlin and Swift. Built JournalDev’s first Android app from scratch; the site was later acquired by DigitalOcean.

projects.name: Glint
projects.description: Read-only market research for Indian F&O and crypto on iPhone and Mac, in development. Ask in plain language and it answers with charts, scans and option chains from its own market data. It never places an order.
